subject.title: Prompt-cache prefix churn on OpenAI models: per-turn dynamic injections (message tool hint + volatile system-prompt section) defeat automatic prefix caching

question: Should OpenAI/Codex Responses preserve OpenClaw's internal cache boundary by moving dynamic/current-turn suffix text after replayed history while keeping strict message-tool delivery through a separate prompt-facing mode?
rationale: The source-level cache fix is clear, but it changes where delivery and authorization guidance appears and overlaps the ambient room_event tool-inventory policy in #102189.

options.title: Accept Boundary-Preserving PR
options.body: Review #102189 and merge once maintainers accept stable-prefix instructions/tools plus dynamic-tail guidance as the intended OpenAI/Codex contract.

options.title: Revise The Policy Split
options.body: Require #102189 to preserve a different room_event or owner-tool inventory contract while still fixing the Responses boundary flattening.

options.title: Keep Current Steering
options.body: Leave the current pre-history instruction/tool steering in place and document the OpenAI/Codex cache cost as intentional.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary-Preserving PR
recommendation.body: Review #102189 and merge once maintainers accept stable-prefix instructions/tools plus dynamic-tail guidance as the intended OpenAI/Codex contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is closest to the visible-reply and ambient room_event policy history.
